newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 83.4 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 83.4 bln marks in tender at 3 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said on Wednesday it allocated securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed three percent rate, the rate that has prevailed since late August.

The central bank accepted bids for 83.4 billion marks of the 15-day funds. A repo pact for 77 billion marks at a fixed three percent rate expires today, Wednesday, so a net 6.4 billion marks is flowing into the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 245.3 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. It accepted 34 percent of the bids. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
